d10_s3: At a stone well surrounded by flocks of sheep, a grown man about 35 with olive-brown skin, neat short black beard, indigo wool tunic with cream border and striped mantle, shepherd's staff, rolls a heavy stone off the well's mouth as a grown woman about 28 with light olive skin, long dark braid, sky-blue linen dress with white woven border arrives with her sheep, both clearly adults, ancient Haran, no modern objects
d13_s1: a grown man in his late twenties with warm brown skin, short curly black hair and a short beard, wearing a long-sleeved ankle-length coat of many colours woven in stripes of red, blue, gold and green, walks across a field toward a group of rough bearded older shepherd brothers in earth-toned wool tunics who glare at him with jealousy, all adults, ancient Canaan, no modern objects
d13_s2: a grown man in his late twenties with warm brown skin, short curly black hair and a short beard, wearing a coat of many colours, sits at a campfire telling his dream while bearded adult brothers scowl, above them a vision of golden wheat sheaves bowing to one standing sheaf, ancient Canaan night, no modern objects
d14_s1: In a grand ancient Egyptian house with painted columns, a grown man about 30 with warm brown skin, short curly black hair, short beard, wearing a white linen Egyptian tunic with long sleeves and a wide beaded collar oversees servants and papyrus scrolls with quiet confidence as an older Egyptian official nods approvingly, ancient Egypt, no modern objects
d14_s2: a grown man about 30 with warm brown skin, short curly black hair, short beard, white linen Egyptian tunic, hurries out of an ancient Egyptian stone hallway leaving his outer white linen cloak behind, the cloak held by a woman's hand with gold bracelets reaching from a doorway, only the hand is seen, ancient Egypt, no modern objects
